cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of done-criteria (done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner) with contract handoff to stage-gates
cases.inputPrompt: Use done-criteria on our cyberpunk shoe product-hero-v0 recipe to pin one measurable done condition, an iteration cap of 3 lookdev passes, and 4 explicit out-of-scope items.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (locked_3d_brief) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces definition_of_done_checklist, max_iteration_caps_per_stage, halt_and_escalation_triggers for role done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to stage-gates (Per-stage workflow gates)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs definition_of_done_checklist, max_iteration_caps_per_stage, halt_and_escalation_triggers conforming to skills/done-criteria/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to stage-gates in skills/done-criteria/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete definition_of_done_checklist and hand off to stage-gates (Per-stage workflow gates).
simulatedOutput.summary: Pinned single measurable stop condition, 3-pass lookdev iteration cap, and 4 explicit out-of-scope exclusions before execution. Delivered single measurable stop condition, out-of-scope list, iteration cap and routed to stage-gates.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary upstream_reference contract handoff from done-criteria to intent-to-3d-brief-writer
cases.inputPrompt: While applying done-criteria, the workflow context is {"goal.clarity":"clear","brief.locked":false} (Intent brief). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the upstream_reference handoff predicate in skills/done-criteria/contract.json
Routes to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Intent brief) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract upstream_reference handoff predicate match to intent-to-3d-brief-writer

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow upstream_reference handoff to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Intent brief).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered upstream_reference handoff from done-criteria to intent-to-3d-brief-writer under context {"goal.clarity":"clear","brief.locked":false}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in done-criteria
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during done-criteria with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for done-criteria and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/done-criteria/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for done-criteria.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (locked_3d_brief) for done-criteria halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Define the stop condition for our Blender project without telling me what deliverable is being produced or what quality bar applies.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'locked_3d_brief' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar required by done-criteria (locked_3d_brief)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'locked_3d_brief' (target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar (locked_3d_brief) before done-criteria locks definition_of_done_checklist.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted done-criteria due to missing required input 'locked_3d_brief' (target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar when 'locked_3d_brief' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (pure exploration or brainstorming) is excluded from done-criteria and delegated to blender-brainstorming
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of define explicit "done" conditions for a blender recipe before starting work, so the agent stops at the right point instead of drifting into endless polish., handle this request inside done-criteria: pure exploration or brainstorming.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/done-criteria/contract.json when pure exploration or brainstorming
Delegates to blender-brainstorming (use blender-brainstorming; goal is divergence) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Exclusion delegation to blender-brainstorming per skills/done-criteria/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for done-criteria (pure exploration or brainstorming); delegate to blender-brainstorming.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced done-criteria exclusion boundary (use blender-brainstorming; goal is divergence) and delegated to blender-brainstorming.
warnings: done-criteria is scoped to done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner and does not absorb blender-brainstorming responsibilities.
